meta.name: scaffold-exercises
meta.description: Create exercise directory structures with sections, problems, solutions, and explainers that pass linting. Use when user wants to scaffold exercises, create exercise stubs, or set up a new course section.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速创建符合规范的练习目录结构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要批量生成带题目、解答和说明的练习目录。
copy.tagline_en: Quickly scaffold exercise directories with linted structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to generate exercise directories with sections, problems, and solutions.

howto.what: Claude 会根据你的课程计划，自动创建练习目录结构，包括章节、练习子文件夹（problem、solution、explainer），并生成对应的 readme.md 文件，最后运行 lint 检查确保格式正确。
howto.when: 当你要求创建练习目录、搭建练习框架或设置新的课程章节时触发。

say.text: 帮我搭建第5章记忆技能练习的目录结构
say.note: Claude 会创建章节和练习文件夹及 readme 文件。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically creates exercise directory structures with sections, problems, solutions, and explainers based on your plan, generates readme.md stubs, and runs lint to validate.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to scaffold exercises, create exercise stubs, or set up a new course section.

say_en.text: Scaffold the directory structure for Chapter 5 Memory Skill Building exercises.
say_en.note: Claude creates section and exercise folders with readme stubs.

say_en.text: Create explainer, problem, and solution subfolders for 05.02 Short-term Memory.
say_en.note: Claude creates the specified subfolders and readme stubs.
